title: Amazon IPO: $1000 to $1.5M Was Not A Smooth Ride
description:
Everyone knows Amazon stock made early investors rich. What they don't talk about is the brutal volatility along the way. To get to the millions, you had to survive two separate crashes that wiped out over 90% of your investment.

#Amazon #Investing #StockMarket #TimeInTheMarket #Volatility

title: Missing 10 Days in the Market Cuts Your Return in Half
description:
The stock market's biggest gains often happen in just a few days. Staying invested is more important than trying to time the market. We break down the real cost of missing the best days.

#investing #stockmarket #personalfinance #timeinthemarket #finance

title: He Bought Pizza for $41 with $690 Million in Bitcoin
description:
In 2010, a programmer paid 10,000 bitcoin for two pizzas. We break down what that amount of BTC would be worth at its peak, and the lesson it teaches about volatility and risk.

#bitcoin #investing #personalfinance #crypto #market

title: Warren Buffett Made 99% of His Money After 50
description:
Warren Buffett is seen as an investing genius, but the real source of his wealth is simpler: time. Over 99% of his net worth was generated after his 50th birthday, proving the incredible power of long-term compounding.

#compounding #investing #warrenbuffett #personalfinance #longterminvesting

title: How Investing for 10 Years Can Beat Investing for 30
description:
Two people invest the same amount monthly. One invests for 10 years and stops. The other invests for 30 years straight. The person who invested less, but started earlier, wins. This isn't a trick, it's the math of compounding.

#investing #compounding #personalfinance #retirement #money
